messages:
sara: @here New dedicated capacity available: A100X-80GB pools in eu-central-1 (3 AZs) and eu-west-3 (initial single AZ). Reservations open now. Docs: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/a100x-eu

jia: heads-up — initial pool is limited. Current inventory: ~6 racks in eu-central-1, 2 racks in eu-west-3. Were enforcing a per-customer cap of 4 racks until 2026-04-10 to make fair distribution while we warm the region.

eli: quick Q — is there an on-demand fallback if a customer exceeds reserved capacity or we run out?

sara: yes. Fallback routing available to compatible model variants on L40s or instanced H100 pools. Expect ~15-25% perf delta for large context workloads. Reserved pricing applies to committed racks; fallback billed at on-demand rates. See pricing section in the doc for exact numbers.

marco: how do customers request reservations? API + console? anything special for migration?

sara: both. Console -> Dedicated -> New Reservation or use API. Example request below (basic):
```
POST /v1/dedicated/reservations
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "region": "eu-central-1",
  "gpu_type": "a100x-80gb",
  "racks": 2,
  "commit_term_days": 90
}
```
Reply includes reservation_id and estimated provisioning ETA. Migration helpers: we provide a KV-cache warmup tool and guided rollout steps in the migration doc.

devops-bot: Capacity tag created: dedicated:a100x:eu-central-1 (cap-id: cap-17905). Autoscaling policy template "dedicated-a100x-default" pushed to org config.

ops_lead: Note for large accounts: Solutions & Support are offering free migration planning for first-month reservations in these regions. Office hour scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC (invite sent to customers flagged as "high-traffic").

sara: TL;DR: A100X-80GB pools live in eu-central-1 + eu-west-3, limited initial inventory, per-customer cap=4 racks until 2026-04-10, reserve via Console/API, fallback to compatible pools exists, support + office hour available. Ping me or @solutions for coordination :party:
